tournament.name: Fuguete Champ 246 - Play Point P/ Top 10

decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost, aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By using efficient creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. Cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Rally at the Hornburg help to maintain momentum and push through any potential blockers. With a heavy emphasis on speed and damage output, this deck is designed to end games swiftly.

The deck focuses on using cheap, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage quickly. By utilizing efficient creatures like Goblin Tomb Raider and Voldaren Epicure, along with a suite of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Clockwork Percussionist and Thermo-Alchemist help to consistently chip away at the opponent's life total while maintaining a steady stream of damage.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Elves, utilizing mana dorks like Birchlore Rangers and Priest of Titania to ramp up quickly. Supporting cards like Timberwatch Elf and Elvish Vanguard help to buff and protect the Elf creatures, while Lead the Stampede and Distant Melody ensure a steady stream of creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early and utilize the synergy between the Elves to quickly close out the game.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. By efficiently dealing damage using cards like Lightning Bolt, Fireblast, and Fiery Temper, while also playing aggressive creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Sneaky Snacker, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. In addition, cards like Lava Dart and Highway Robbery provide additional reach and damage potential. The deck is focused on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to win the game as fast as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by using cheap aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing a fast-paced game and constantly targeting the opponent's life total, the deck aims to overwhelm and defeat the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize or build up their board. The combination of creatures with direct damage spells allows for a versatile and aggressive strategy that puts pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, maintaining control of the game through countermagic and card draw. Delver of Secrets, Cryptic Serpent, and Tolarian Terror provide early threats, while spells like Dispel, Spell Pierce, and Counterspell help protect them. Brainstorm, Mental Note, and Thought Scour enable card filtering and graveyard filling, while Lórien Revealed and Sleep of the Dead offer additional control and disruption. The deck aims to keep up the pressure and disrupt the opponent's plans to secure a quick victory.

The primary theme of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Sneaky Snacker, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fiery Temper, the deck aims to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Faithless Looting and Alms of the Vein allow for card advantage and additional reach, while maintaining pressure on the opponent. With a focus on speed and aggression, this Rakdos Aggro deck is designed to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by efficient burn spells. The deck aims to quickly lower the opponent's life total by playing low-cost creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Voldaren Epicure, while dealing direct damage with burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of cards like Rally at the Hornburg and Clockwork Percussionist helps to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. Overall, this deck focuses on speed, efficiency, and relentless aggression to secure victory in a Pauper 1 vs 1 match.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on consistently applying pressure to the opponent through a mix of creatures and removal spells. Cuombajj Witches and Chittering Rats disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Gray Merchant of Asphodel provides a significant life swing. Refurbished Familiar and Tithing Blade help to increase the deck's aggression, with support from spells like Mephitic Draught and Defile for removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to secure victory in Pauper 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with mana-producing Elves and powerful creatures while using cards like Winding Way and Lead the Stampede to draw more creatures. The deck relies on synergies between Elves, such as Priest of Titania generating massive amounts of mana and Timberwatch Elf giving a significant power boost to other creatures. The inclusion of cards like Masked Vandal provides some removal options, while Wellwisher helps to offset aggressive strategies with lifegain. The ultimate goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of Elves and close out the game swiftly.

The main concept of this Pauper 1 vs 1 Control - Ephemerate deck is to establish board control and card advantage through efficient creatures like God-Pharaoh's Faithful and Mulldrifter, along with powerful instant and sorcery spells like Ephemerate and Snap. The deck focuses on recurring value from creatures like Archaeomancer and Sunscape Familiar, while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Prohibit and Negate. The goal is to out-value the opponent by drawing cards, countering threats, and controlling the board until you can overwhelm them with powerful spells and card advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts to power up creatures and generate extra value through sacrificing and drawing cards. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The mana base includes artifact lands and other color fixing lands to ensure smooth mana development. The deck leverages the affinity mechanic to reduce the cost of casting artifacts and maximize efficiency. It combines fast aggression and card advantage to keep up pressure on the opponent and close out games quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with artifacts to enable powerful synergies and abilities that can overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer and Refurbished Familiar, this Aggro-Affinity deck aims to quickly build a strong presence on the battlefield and deal damage efficiently. With a mix of card draw, removal, and burn spells, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a fast-paced, aggressive manner, utilizing the affinity mechanic to maximize its potential.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing and recurring creatures to generate value and control the board. By utilizing cards like Refurbished Familiar, Ichor Wellspring, and Fanatical Offering, the deck can consistently draw cards and bring back creatures from the graveyard. Additionally, cards like Krark-Clan Shaman and Cleansing Wildfire provide disruption and removal options while Nyxborn Hydra and Writhing Chrysalis serve as powerful threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and resource management.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by playing aggressive creatures like Sneaky Snacker and Kessig Flamebreather, while also utilizing spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Dart, and Fiery Temper to burn them directly. Additional damage can be done with cards like Guttersnipe and Fireblast. Faithless Looting helps to filter through the deck for key cards, while Grab the Prize and Highway Robbery provide extra resources. All in all, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and direct burn spells.

This deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm opponents with quick creature drops and efficient burn spells. The goal is to deal damage quickly and consistently, using low-cost creatures and direct damage spells to control the board and win the game as fast as possible. The synergy between the creatures and burn spells allows for a high level of versatility in dealing with different threats, while the cards like Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt provide extra reach to finish off opponents. Overall, the deck aims to be a relentless, fast-paced powerhouse in the Pauper format.
